what: The twelve Olympus art filters unchanged; film looks loaded from the SD card with Custom Menu J, Load Looks, overwrite the entries the file lists; interval shooting with up to 240 frames, a level gauge with calibration, and focus peaking; a Debug Log row in Custom Menu J (Off by default) that writes EPM2LOG.BIN to the card for bug reports; a Lowest S/S Setting row in Custom Menu E (the shutter speed at which ISO Auto starts to rise in P and A); the Firmware screen shows the build's label (Body : 1.6  EPM2Mod 2026.11.19)
